title: AI analysis with exact dosing
caption:
Still guessing how much to dose? 🧪

Tap Analyze and ReefBuddy's AI dosing calculator reads your numbers against your tank's size, type and history. You get a plain-English summary, specific recommendations and dosing amounts worked out for YOUR volume.
Not "add some buffer". Exact amounts.

3 analyses free on iOS, no subscription. Link in bio.

Two-part, all-in-one or kalk? Tell us your method 👇
